meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: MUST USE for planning before coding when design uncertainty remains after discovery: ambiguous scope, competing decompositions, unclear boundaries, uncertain dependency ordering, architecture decisions, a vague 'just make it good / figure out what to build' brief, or any request to plan, interview, or break work down. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode, just make it good, figure out what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前制定完整的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手编码前先理清范围、分解任务并制定执行计划。
copy.tagline_en: Create a complete work plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify scope, decompose tasks, and create an execution plan before coding.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先探索代码库，只问几个关键问题，然后写出一份完整的、无需再问就能执行的工作计划。它只生成计划，绝不自己动手写代码。
howto.when: 当你说“做个计划”、“先规划再编码”、“分解这个任务”等，或者需求模糊（如“把它做好”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一下这个新功能怎么做。
say.note: Claude 会开始探索并提问，然后给出计划。

say.text: 先分解这个任务，再开始编码。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份任务分解计划。

say.text: 把登录模块的改进方案规划出来。
say.note: Claude 会针对登录模块做规划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first explores the codebase, asks only a few sharp questions, then writes a single decision-complete work plan that a worker can execute without further interview. It only plans, never implements.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'plan this', 'make a plan', 'break this down', 'just make it good', or similar requests, especially when the requirement is vague or involves design uncertainty.

say_en.text: Plan this new feature for me.
say_en.note: Claude will explore and ask questions, then produce a plan.

say_en.text: Break this task down before coding.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a task breakdown plan.

say_en.text: Plan the improvements for the login module.
say_en.note: Claude will plan specifically for the login module.
